brand.name: Lease Loop
brand.tagline: Circular leasing for e-bikes, laptops and farm machines
catalogue.title: The tech you want. No strings attached.
catalogue.empty: No items are available right now.
condition.label: Condition
status.label: Status
auth.name: Full name
auth.passwordHint: Use a unique passphrase of 15–128 characters.
auth.intro: One account to manage your relationship with Lease Loop.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.registerError: We could not create your account. Check your details, or sign in if you already have an account.
auth.loginError: We could not sign you in. Check your email and password.
auth.networkError: We could not connect. Please try again.
account.title: My account
account.intro: Manage your profile and account security. Your leasing journey will live here.
account.updateError: We could not save your changes. Check your details and, if changing your password, your current password.
account.passwordNote: Changing your password signs out your other devices.
dashboard.title: Your leasing space
dashboard.intro: Everything you need to follow your leases.
dashboard.emptyText: Your leases will appear here once your agreement is ready.
dashboard.demoExplanation: Development demo: creates simulated lease and payment records for your account. No real asset or payment is affected.
dashboard.demoError: The demo could not be created. Check that the database is set up.
dashboard.demoNotice: Demo lease: the agreement, invoice and payment are simulated.
dashboard.paymentsIntro: Issued invoices and recorded payments. Forecasts are shown on each lease.
dashboard.noInvoices: No invoices have been issued yet.
dashboard.requestsIntro: Requests are reviewed before your agreement changes.
dashboard.noRequests: You have no requests yet. Open a lease to request a change.
dashboard.requestSent: Request sent. Your current lease remains active while it is reviewed.
dashboard.requestUnavailable: A request is already pending or this lease is no longer active.
dashboard.requestError: We could not send the request. Please try again.
dashboard.lockedExplanation: Your net rent is locked in the agreement. VAT is calculated for each invoice date.
dashboard.forecastTotalNote: Includes the down payment and monthly invoices including VAT; excludes the optional buyout. Future VAT may change.
dashboard.forecastUnavailable: A forecast is unavailable because a VAT rate is missing.
dashboard.vatExplanation: Net rent is locked; the VAT rate on each invoice date determines the tax. The 2027 rate is fictional.
dashboard.forecastNote: These are estimates, not issued invoices. VAT may change.
dashboard.manageInfo: Choose an option to request a review. Your current agreement continues until a change is approved.
dashboard.returnTerms: Any return charges are determined after review.
dashboard.buyoutTerms: End-of-term price: {amount} excl. VAT. An early buyout requires a separate quote.
dashboard.exchangeTerms: Replacement availability and any charges need review.
dashboard.passportIntro: Current item details and its previous lease count.
dashboard.impactNote: Estimate for this reuse life, assuming one refurbishment and using fictional manufacturing factors adjusted for condition. It is not a measured saving.
dashboard.noImpact: No reuse saving is estimated for the first life. Factors are fictional.
dashboard.noEvents: No events have been recorded yet.
photo.title: Photo credits
photo.intro: These photographs illustrate fictional products; they do not show the actual items. Images have been resized for the site.
product.estimate: Estimate including VAT. The item and price are confirmed at checkout.
product.unavailable: This item is not currently available to lease. You can still explore pricing.
product.error.below_minimum: The financed amount is below the leasing minimum. Reduce your down payment.
product.error.above_maximum: The financed amount exceeds the leasing maximum. Increase your down payment.
product.error.unknown_term: This lease term is not supported.
product.error.invalid_down_payment: Choose a down payment between zero and the list price.
product.intro: Choose your term and down payment. See your monthly rent change as you adjust.
product.description.e_bike: Check the distance ridden, condition and previous leases to get to know this e-bike.
product.description.laptop: Review the battery cycles, condition and model year of this laptop.
product.description.farm_machine: Review the engine hours, condition and model year of this farm machine.
product.endIntro: At the end of your lease, choose the next step under your contract.
product.end.buy.title: Make it yours
product.end.buy.body: Buy the item at the end-of-term buyout price agreed in your contract.
product.end.return.title: Return it
product.end.return.body: Return the item so it can be assessed, refurbished and leased again.
product.end.pass.title: Pass it on
product.end.pass.body: Explore a transfer to another customer, subject to approval and the terms of your contract.
cart.title: Your cart
cart.locationNote: For this simulation, the location is not saved or sent to a delivery service.
cart.paymentNote: Simulated payment method. No payment details are collected and no payment is taken.
cart.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
cart.changed: A price or product has changed. Refresh the page and review your cart.
cart.simulation: Simulated checkout: no real payment or delivery will happen. VAT and future totals are estimates; buyout is optional and not included in the rent total.
dashboard.forecastChangesNote: Only payment changes are shown. The amount stays the same each month within the dates shown.
application.title: Apply for your lease
application.intro: Tell us about the applicant. We will check the eligibility rules for all items in your cart.
application.notice: This checks your answers against sample eligibility rules. It does not sign a contract, reserve an item or take payment.
application.changed: Your cart is empty, unavailable or has changed. Review it before applying.
application.expired: This quote is from an earlier day. Apply again for current prices and eligibility.
application.login: Please sign in to submit your application.
application.incomplete: Please complete all applicable questions with valid answers.
application.error: We could not submit your application. Please try again.
application.status.manual_review: A person needs to review your application
application.outcome.approved: Your application passed the eligibility rules for this cart.
application.outcome.rejected: We cannot approve this application based on these answers. You can review the information and apply again.
application.outcome.manual_review: A person must review this application before you can continue. No contract has been signed.
application.reason.under_age: You must be at least 18 on the lease start date. You can apply once you meet this requirement.
application.reason.residency: Residence must be in Finland, Sweden or Estonia.
application.reason.affordability: The combined monthly rent including VAT exceeds 30% of your monthly net income.
application.reason.business_id: The business ID does not pass its check-digit validation. Please check it.
application.reason.financed_limits: The combined financed amount is outside the supported financing limits.
application.reason.pep: A politically exposed person requires manual review.
application.reason.signatory: An authorized company signatory must be involved before a contract can be signed.
application.reason.large_amount: Financing of €50,000 or more requires a person to review the application.
application.reason.income_check: The question flow did not collect income for this amount, so a person must check affordability.
application.reason.incomplete: Some required answers are missing or invalid.
application.reason.blocked_answer: An answer does not meet the application requirements.
application.why.q_customer_type: Determines which questions and eligibility rules apply.
application.why.q_birth_date: Checks that you are at least 18 on the lease start date.
application.why.q_email: Provides a contact address for the application.
application.why.q_country: Leasing is available to residents of Finland, Sweden and Estonia.
application.why.q_employment: Helps assess whether rent fits your budget.
application.why.q_monthly_income: Combined monthly rent including VAT may be at most 30% of net income.
application.why.q_business_id: Checks the Finnish business ID format and check digit; it does not verify registry status.
application.why.q_company_name: Identifies the company applying for the lease.
application.why.q_can_sign: A company contract needs an authorized signatory.
application.why.q_signatory_email: Identifies a contact who is authorized to sign; this form does not send a contract.
application.why.q_usage_purpose: Helps explain how the e-bike will be used.
application.why.q_farm_registry: Identifies the farm or contractor applying for machinery.
application.why.q_annual_revenue: Financing of €50,000 or more requires business due diligence.
application.why.q_beneficial_owners: Identifies owners for review of higher-value applications.
application.why.q_pep: Politically exposed applicants or owners require manual review.
application.why.q_pep_details: Provides context for the required manual review.
dashboard.buyoutEstimate: Buyout and future VAT are estimates until confirmed.
return.title: Return your item
return.intro: Tell us how the item is doing. A professional will assess it and prepare your return quote.
return.reportedCondition: How would you describe its condition?
return.usageHint: Use the current lifetime reading, not the amount since your last payment.
return.issuesHint: Choose all that apply. Leave these unchecked if everything works well.
return.reviewNote: This sends a request. Your lease remains active until the return is confirmed and the item is received. You can review the quote before accepting.
return.submitError: We could not send the request. Check the details and whether another request is already open.
return.acceptError: The quote could not be accepted. It may have expired; please refresh the page.
return.quoteNote: Assessment dated {date}. This quote includes unpaid invoices and any accrued rent not yet invoiced.
return.quoteExpired: This quote has expired. The assessment team needs to refresh it before you can accept.
return.acceptedNote: Quote accepted. Your lease remains active until the team confirms receipt of the item.
return.paymentRequired: This buyout needs a recorded payment. Contact the team to complete it.
recovery.queueIntro: Review customer reports, assess the item, and prepare its next life.
recovery.empty: No return or buyout requests yet.
recovery.inspectionIntro: Confirm the condition and required work. The calculation is saved as a quote for the customer to review.
recovery.repairNote: For faults outside the standard service plan. Describe the repairs below.
recovery.quoteNote: Amounts follow the saved assessment and include VAT. Settlement includes unpaid invoices and accrued unbilled rent.
recovery.awaitCustomer: The customer must accept the quote before receipt.
recovery.workCompleted: I confirm all listed work is completed, reported faults are resolved, and the item is safe to lease.
recovery.beforeQuote: Complete the assessment to calculate the figures.
recovery.error: The action could not be completed. Review the values, request status and quote date.
recovery.historyIntro: Completed work recorded before this item was made available again.
recovery.task.good->like_new: Improve good condition to like new
return.buyoutMethod: The remaining agreed rents and final buyout are discounted to today. Outstanding invoices are added once.
return.returnMethod: The remaining agreement value is reduced by expected recovery after refurbishment. The early-return charge is capped at the discounted remaining rents. Outstanding invoices are added once.
